mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MATE (user_id, title, content, img, visibility, status, country, recruit_count, recruit_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{img}, #{visibility}, #{status}, #{country}, #{recruitCount}, #{recruitStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT m.mate_id AS mateId, m.user_id AS userId, m.title, m.content, m.img, m.visibility, m.view_count AS viewCount, m.status, m.deleted_by_user_id AS deletedByUserId, m.deleted_at AS deletedAt, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.country, m.recruit_count AS recruitCount, m.recruit_status AS recruitStatus, u.nickname AS nickname FROM TB_MATE m JOIN TB_USER u ON m.user_id = u.user_id WHERE m.mate_id = #{mateId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MATE SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, country = #{country}, recruit_count = #{recruitCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE TB_MATE SET img = #{img}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: UPDATE TB_MATE SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_by_user_id = #{userId}, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT mate_id AS mateId, user_id AS userId, title, content, img, visibility, view_count AS viewCount, status, deleted_by_user_id AS deletedByUserId, deleted_at AS deletedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, country, recruit_count AS recruitCount, recruit_status AS recruitStatus FROM TB_MATE WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND visibility = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT m.mate_id AS mateId, m.user_id AS userId, m.title, m.content, m.img, m.visibility, m.view_count AS viewCount, m.status, m.deleted_by_user_id AS deletedByUserId, m.deleted_at AS deletedAt, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.country, m.recruit_count AS recruitCount, m.recruit_status AS recruitStatus, u.nickname AS nickname,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MATE_LIKE ml WHERE ml.mate_id = m.mate_id ) AS likeCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MATE_COMMENT mc WHERE mc.mate_id = m.mate_id AND mc.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS commentCount
FROM TB_MATE m
JOIN TB_USER u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.visibility = 'PUBLIC'
AND m.country IN
#{countryKeyword}
AND ( m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.country LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.recruit_status = 'OPEN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
m.view_count DESC, m.created_at DESC
likeCount DESC, m.created_at DESC
m.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MATE WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND visibility = 'PUBLIC'
AND country IN
#{countryKeyword}
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR country LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT m.mate_id AS mateId, m.user_id AS userId, m.title, m.content, m.img, m.visibility, m.view_count AS viewCount, m.status, m.deleted_by_user_id AS deletedByUserId, m.deleted_at AS deletedAt, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.country, m.recruit_count AS recruitCount, m.recruit_status AS recruitStatus, u.nickname AS nickname,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MATE_LIKE ml WHERE ml.mate_id = m.mate_id ) AS likeCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MATE_COMMENT mc WHERE mc.mate_id = m.mate_id AND mc.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS commentCount
FROM TB_MATE m
JOIN TB_USER u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MATE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MATE SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE TB_MATE SET recruit_status = #{recruitStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE mate_id = #{mateId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT mate_id AS mateId, user_id AS userId, visibility, status FROM TB_MATE WHERE mate_id = #{value} FOR UPDATE
